items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: So I went right in to see Sidney sittin' in his room like this and I knocked on his door - 'Good', I said, 'Benny Waters' - he knew me, you know, see.

ctx.x: PS: So you didn't see Bechet too much after that.

Naah, nah. And then, and the last time I saw Sidney Bechet - well, not exactly the last time that I saw him in the theater but I was playing in a place called Cannuck [?], Belgium, which Cannuck, Belgium is considered the greatest - what do you call those things - casinos, supposed to be the greatest casino in Europe, Cannuck. Supposed to be, they have all the big things that they have, the shows and they have the model shows, [ ], you know - fashion shows, see, had all big things. Well, I was playing the…
